modes.title: Rear brake duct restriction
symptoms: front-left stays under 700°C in the same window
brake_pressure peaks early and trails as speed falls
oil_pressure soft under sustained heavy (correlate, not root cause)
actions: Inspect rear tape / blanking before touching the front ducts
Compare front vs rear in the heavy window
Confirm the stop is a trail on brake_pressure, not a late stab
Confirm oil dip tracks brake energy, not pump
